newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek C/A deficit drops to $8.0 mln in September.
newsitem.headline: Greek C/A deficit drops to $8.0 mln in September.

text.p: Greece's current account deficit fell provisionally to $8.0 million in September from $289.1 million in the same month a year ago, the Bank of Greece said in a statement.
The cumulative current account deficit surged to $3.6 billion in the first nine months of 1996 from $2.436 billion in the same period in 1995, it said.
The trade deficit rose 27.4 percent to $1.629 billion in September from $1.279 billion the same month in 1995.
The cumulative trade deficit rose 7.4 percent to $13.413 billion in the period January-September 1996 from from $12.494 billion in the same period in 1995.
